answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Famed flight dispatcher commission with flight dispatchers attestation stops them at the door: a commission dispatchers renew after schedule audits, which means the horizon of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the orchard is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the zenith for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
